I'm pretty sure that the LA contingent is committed to the Comfort
Suites. I know Mike Courtois has booked at least one room there,
don't know how many Angelenos are also planning to attend.

The Comfort Suites is $109 a night for "the big rooms", less
for the non-big, extra discount if 10+ rooms were reserved by the
group. They do have an indoor pool, according to Mike it's laid
out just like the one at the Milwaukee airport, so you could do
a complete reenactment if you like. ;-)

The reservation I made downtown through GenCon was $127 a night.
I don't know if prices have changed or anything since then...

You'd have to make some effort, probably, to find out exactly

there are links from the GenCon home page to go through their
booking system, http://www.gencon.com/.
